name: @eq-solutions/contracts
author: CDC Solutions Pty Ltd
description: Canonical cross-app contracts for the EQ suite. v0.1: the Shell→Service login-handoff JWT app_metadata claim shape (ShellHandoffClaims) + a dependency-free runtime validator. v0.2: TenantBrandKit — the one shape every surface uses for a tenant's brand in documents/emails (palette, measured logos, fonts, legal footer) + validator + neutral fallback + JSON Schema for non-TS consumers (eq-cards). Imported by eq-shell, eq-service, eq-field (via @eq-solutions/documents) and eq-cards.
